title: Widen database column to BIGINT when int64 alert rule fields exceed SMALLINT limit
answers: Why does saving an alert rule fail when missing-series evaluations to resolve exceeds 32767?
How to fix SMALLINT column overflow for missing series resolution counts in Grafana Alerting?
Can missing-series evals to resolve be set higher than 32,767 in alert rules?
body:
Symptom: Configuring an alert rule missing-series resolution count above 32,767 fails to persist on MySQL or PostgreSQL.
Root cause: pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/ualert/alert_rule_missing_series_evals_to_resolve.go:AddAlertRuleMissingSeriesEvalsToResolve configured missing_series_evals_to_resolve as SMALLINT while the model uses int64.
Fix pattern: Add raw SQL migrations like pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/ualert/alert_rule_missing_series_evals_to_resolve.go:ExpandAlertRuleMissingSeriesEvalsToResolve to alter the column type to BIGINT across MySQL and PostgreSQL.
Constraints: Applies when int64 model fields are persisted in narrower database columns; does not apply if the database column already accommodates int64 range.
applies: Grafana Alerting alert rule database schema on MySQL and PostgreSQL
